_readme: Career chapters shown on the 3D Menu corkboards (Play > level select). Edit and press Play; no code change needed.
chapters: in story order. A chapter unlocks when the previous playable chapter is PASSED (see each level's rewards.json passingPercent).
id: the level id used in the save (Level_01...). number: big number on the pinned paper. noteTitle: short text on the paper. title + description: the chapter sheet.
scene: the scene to load. Leave it empty, or set comingSoon true, to pin a grey Coming Soon paper that cannot be opened.

campaignPending: true = the chapter still plays in isolation but is not part of the updated story yet; a New Game campaign shows it as PENDING UPDATE and cannot launch it (Level 2 until Delivery B T21 removes the flag).
cases: cases in the level; only used for the EXP/hearts maximum before the first result is saved.
badgeSlots: how many badge spaces the story board shows (filled in sideQuests order; the rest stay empty until a new side quest is added).

sideQuests: one paper per side quest. chapterId: the chapter it belongs to (tapping it opens that chapter). number: the side quest number written on its badge paper. The badge art and name come from that chapter's rewards.json sideQuest (badgeId, badgeName, badgeEmblem, badgeRibbon).
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
